inputs.text: Black spade marks ONLY on him; red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Surrealist oil painting in the style of Salvador Dali, meticulous classical hyper-detail, double image: the spade king with silver-grey hair, spade crown and spade-marked armor embraces the diamond queen with very long red-orange hair, tiara and diamond-marked gown in a ballroom where the embracing couple also forms the shape of a giant watchful face, the chandelier above melts and drips golden light over them, marble floor tiles curl upward at the edges like breaking waves, distant columns dissolve into a desert horizon, earth tones with deep blue night and golden highlights, dreamlike paranoiac atmosphere
